reviewMethod.wholeSourcePurity: Full-source 15 fps whole-body and lower-body visual review was completed before any count was admitted.
reviewMethod.targetedDenseReview: 30 fps start/end boundary review was used on PASS clips to confirm first/last completed takeoff-airborne-landing cycles.
reviewMethod.locatorPolicy: Programmatic motion/appearance signals were used only as candidate-time locators. They did not decide jump-rope type and did not generate GT counts.
reviewMethod.mixedTypePolicy: Any alternate-foot, boxer-step, high-knee, crossover, mixed subtype, or ambiguous non-synchronized footwork anywhere in the source rejects the clip from STANDARD.

rows.note: Opening lower-body sequence already shows repeated unilateral support and alternating knee/foot lift. Not synchronized two-foot STANDARD; no GT count admitted.
